people.name: Gad

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

translations.web: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
translations.bsb: Then Leah said, “How fortunate!” So she named him Gad.
translations.kjv: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
translations.asv: And Leah said, Fortunate! and she called his name Gad.
